Method of Attack: Privilege escalation by any registered user to gain administrative access
Lack of proper nonce checks and current_user_can() permission checks in administrative functions
Unauthorized administrative actions including downloading/reading files, uploading files, updating plugin settings, injecting into posts
Impacted Systems: WordPress sites using AMP for WP plugin
Attack Vector: Exploitation of missing authorization and nonce verification in plugin administrative endpoints
Indicators of Compromise: Proof-of-concept demonstrated by WebARX showing unauthorized code injection and plugin settings modification
